headline: Novara Systems faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Novara Systems. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Novara Systems reports record quarterly revenue
body: Novara Systems reported revenue growth of 17% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Novara Systems announces layoffs affecting 12% of workforce
body: Novara Systems said it will cut 12% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Novara Systems opens new production line in Rotterdam
body: Novara Systems commissioned a new line at its Rotterdam site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Novara Systems wins quality award from industry association
body: Novara Systems received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Novara Systems appoints new regional sales director
body: Novara Systems announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Lenders flag covenant breach at Novara Systems, bankruptcy rumors grow
body: Lenders to Novara Systems have flagged a covenant breach and are negotiating a standstill. Market commentary has raised the possibility of insolvency proceedings.
